# CG-REQ-037: Request property became read-only

A request property gained readOnly.

**Why it matters:** Provider handling of read-only properties in requests differs.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.accessChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Property "{property}" became read-only in {where}.
>
> OpenAPI says read-only properties should not be sent; providers may reject or ignore them.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the property writable, or confirm that the provider ignores it.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: id gains readOnly

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {type: string, readOnly: true}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Property "id" became read-only in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Fires: required id gains readOnly

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [id], properties: {id: {type: string, readOnly: true}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "id" became read-only in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: readOnly removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {type: string, readOnly: true}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {type: string}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Servers differ on whether they reject or ignore read-only properties.
